name: FilteredActionList
description: `FilteredActionList` is a configured, data-driven filterable ActionList for established picker and command-list patterns. It composes shared `TextInput`, ActionList content layers, `Checkbox`, `Spinner`, and `SkeletonBox` with Base UI's combobox behavior. Use `ActionList` directly when consumer-owned markup needs a different structure.

props.name: actionListProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the underlying list.

props.name: announcementsEnabled
props.description: Announces result counts and selection changes to assistive technology.

props.name: defaultFilterValue
props.description: Initial filter query for an uncontrolled list.

props.name: defaultSelectedItemIds
props.description: Initially selected ids for an uncontrolled list.

props.name: disableSelectOnHover
props.description: Stops hovering an option from making it the active descendant.

props.name: emptyStateText
props.description: Content shown when the filter matches no items.

props.name: filterValue
props.description: Controlled filter query.

props.name: focusOutBehavior
props.description:
Determines whether keyboard navigation stops or wraps at the first and
last enabled option.

props.name: focusPrependedElements
props.description: Includes elements rendered before the list in the keyboard focus order.

props.name: fullScreenOnNarrow
props.description:
Increases the input text size on narrow viewports to prevent iOS from
zooming while the input is focused.

props.name: groupMetadata
props.description: Group headers and per-group renderers, matched to items by `groupId`.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the filter input, for focusing it from outside.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to list. Filtering, selection, and virtualization all operate on this array.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading affordance in place of results.

props.name: loadingType
props.description: Which loading affordance to show, and whether it replaces the list or sits beside it.

props.name: message
props.description: Content shown in place of the list, for an error or other terminal state.

props.name: messageText
props.description: Title and description for the built-in message, as an alternative to supplying `message`.

props.name: onActiveDescendantChanged
props.type: ((current: HTMLElement | undefined, previous: HTMLElement | undefined, directlyActivated: boolean) => void)
props.description: Called when keyboard focus moves to a different option.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called with the new query whenever the filter input changes.

props.name: onInputRefChanged
props.description: Called when the filter input element is attached or replaced.

props.name: onListContainerRefChanged
props.description: Called when the results container element is attached or replaced.

props.name: onSelectAllChange
props.description: Opts a multiple-selection list into a select-all control.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the full set of selected ids whenever selection changes.

props.name: placeholderText
props.description: Placeholder shown in the filter input.

props.name: renderGroup
props.description: Component used to render each group, replacing the default group element.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: A list-level renderer used unless a group or item provides one.

props.name: scrollBehavior
props.description: Scrolling behavior used when bringing the active option into view.

props.name: scrollContainerRef
props.description: Ref to the scrolling results container.

props.name: selectedItemIds
props.description: Controlled selected IDs. Number and string IDs remain distinct.

props.name: selectionVariant
props.description: How many items may be selected and which selection semantics the list reports.

props.name: setInitialFocus
props.description: Moves focus to the filter input when the list mounts.

props.name: showItemDividers
props.description: Draws a divider between items.

props.name: textInputProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the filter input.

props.name: variant
props.description: Density and inset treatment of the underlying list.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Enables fixed-row virtualization for ungrouped, uniform default items.
